# chat

**Qualified name:** `pyrogram.filters.chat`

## Constructor

```python
def __init__(chats: Union[int, str, List[Union[int, str]]] = None): ...
```

## Documentation

Filter messages coming from one or more chats.

You can use [set bound methods](https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#set) to manipulate the
chats container.

### Parameters

- **`chats`** (`int` | `str` | `list`)
  Pass one or more chat ids/usernames to filter chats.
  For your personal cloud (Saved Messages) you can simply use "me" or "self".
  Defaults to None (no chats).

_Source: `pyrogram/filters.py`._
